Name: WEATHER_PARAM_ST
Description: One row per weather. The row ID is the weather type that WeatherLotParam rolls (0 Default, 1 Cloudless, 20 Rain, 40 Snow, 50 Fog, ...). When the current map has an area variant number N, the row N × 100 + weather is used instead if it exists (retail 1020, 5030, ...).

Fields.Name: Weather SFX ID
Fields.Description: SFX played around the camera while this weather is active, indoors and outdoors. Replaced when the weather changes. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Wind SFX ID
Fields.Description: Wind SFX for this weather, created only while the player is outdoors. A wind override set elsewhere replaces it. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Ground Hit SFX ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail 1004010 on the rain rows).

Fields.Name: Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound (SFX-type sound ID, e.g. 806100) played while this weather is active. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Time to Full Wetness
Fields.Description: Seconds for the weather's wetness to rise from 0 to 1 (rate = 1 / value per second). Above 0 also makes this a rain weather: ground materials switch to their HitMtrlParam rain replacement and effects get the rain flag. 0 or -1: no wetness.

Fields.Name: GPARAM ID
Fields.Description: Weather GPARAM: the WWWW of m00_00_WWWW_WeatherOutdoor (and the area's CCWW file). Fades in over 15 seconds when the weather changes. Values above 9999 are not preloaded. Rows can share one.

Fields.Name: Next Weather Lot - Min Duration
Fields.Description: When this weather starts, the next weather roll is scheduled after a random time between Min and Max, in in-game seconds. Min above Max is clamped to Max.

Fields.Name: Next Weather Lot - Max Duration
Fields.Description: Upper end of the random time until the next weather roll, in in-game seconds. If the row is missing, 3600 is used.

Fields.Name: Wet SpEffect [0]
Fields.Description: SpEffect kept on characters while this weather is active (retail 4650-4652 on rain rows). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Wet SpEffect [1]
Fields.Description: SpEffect kept on characters while this weather is active. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Wet SpEffect [2]
Fields.Description: SpEffect kept on characters while this weather is active. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Wet SpEffect [3]
Fields.Description: SpEffect kept on characters while this weather is active. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Wet SpEffect [4]
Fields.Description: SpEffect kept on characters while this weather is active. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Indoor Weather SFX ID
Fields.Description: Extra weather SFX created only while the player is indoors. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Outdoor Weather SFX ID
Fields.Description: Extra weather SFX created only while the player is outdoors (retail 806132 on windy rain). -1: none.

Fields.Name: AI Sight Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplies enemy sight range under the open sky (on top of the time-of-day AI sight rate from GameSystemCommonParam). 1: no change.

Fields.Name: Distant View GPARAM Override Weight
Fields.Description: Stored when the weather changes (-1 if unset); what uses it was not found. Retail 0.3 on rain, snow and fog, 0.05 on Windy Fog, -1 on clear weathers.
